name: Don't Drink That!
summary:
Mayuko, the airhead witch, forgot all the potion recipes...
Wait—Don't Drink That!

Luckily, she remembers just one spell her Master taught her, and it's a time-loop spell! Exploded a vampire? Fizzled a specter? No problem, just loop back and try again!

In this cute puzzle game, you'll experiment with ingredients and mess up gloriously. If you build your knowledge of potion-brewing and your wacky customers, will you be able to complete your first day at your very own potion shop without... incident?
